//: Deno config for the Edge Functions only. It is scoped to supabase/functions/ and has
no effect on the Vite app build.
sloppy-imports lets Deno resolve the game's extensionless relative imports (`./rng`,
`../data/classes`), which Vite resolves natively and stock Deno rejects. Without it,
`import { runFight } from '../../../src/engine/fight'` fails at deploy time.
This is what allows the duel resolver to import the game's REAL combat code instead of
a reimplementation that could drift from it. Six runtime modules resolve through here:
engine/fight, engine/combat, engine/rng, data/classes, data/specs, data/constants.
